description.fallback: Kawaki visits Naruto and Hinata in the Daikokuten dimension. He apologises for them being trapped for so long, stating he must eliminate all the enemies who are a threat to Naruto first. Kawaki admits he isn't keeping Naruto contained for his safety, but to prevent him from having to see Kawaki kill Boruto again.
